authority_boundary.limitation: This validates deterministic model-resource command, replay, checkpoint, mask, event, and growth-response plumbing only. It does not identify glucose, a named nutrient, medium composition, physical concentration, delivery kinetics, or calibrated biological dose.

activation_prerequisites: Issue #918 lands an authoritative apply-model-resource command and model-resource-applied accepted event in the composed Worker/runtime path.
The command is preserved by strict protocol-runtime promotion and experiment-bundle replay/export rather than silently dropped.
Rejected commands are atomic replay no-ops and accepted commands increment commandCount exactly once without advancing biological time.

deterministic_inputs.seed_source: the exact bundled run-preset seed; the experiment must not substitute an ad-hoc seed when validating the product path
deterministic_inputs.resource_value_source: the exact bundled run-preset initialResourceLevel, reused as an engineering model-resource test value rather than a product default or physical dose

spatial_fixture.meaning: deterministic test geometry only; not biological spatial authority

acceptance: accepted event preserves exact command id/order/current biological time
tick and simulationTimeHours do not advance on acceptance
every in-mask resource cell is exactly zero and every off-mask cell remains exactly zero

cases.precondition: start from the accepted global-set-zero checkpoint
acceptance: accepted resource field equals the exact finite Float32 write policy in-mask
off-mask cells remain zero
commandCount increases exactly once and RNG state is unchanged by the deterministic edit
only authoritative in-mask cells selected by the normalized radial geometry are written
renderer/pixel/camera coordinates never enter the command
checkpoint and event retain the exact normalized intervention payload
restoring the accepted intervention checkpoint and advancing the configured tick count yields byte-equivalent authoritative typed state/metrics/events/trace to uninterrupted continuation
replaying the same ordered commands from genesis yields the same accepted snapshots and trace hashes
zero-resource step reports no positive authoritative division biomass
post-replenish step exposes a positive authoritative division/growth response when the existing bundled ecology authority supports it
the result is labelled model-resource mechanism behavior, not nutrient-dose validation

cases.invalid_fixture: a structurally unsupported/non-canonical model-resource intervention payload
acceptance: resource, RNG state, tick, simulationTimeHours, commandCount, event stream, metrics, and trace remain exactly unchanged
no accepted model-resource-applied event is emitted

compact_result_schema.bulky_artifact_policy: Full traces/checkpoints stay under PETRA_LOCAL_ARTIFACT_DIR; only compact scalar/boolean/hash evidence belongs in PETRA_LOCAL_RESULT_JSON.

acceptance: All cases pass on the authoritative composed runtime path.
No test derives resource meaning, bounds, geometry, or efficacy from renderer/UI state.
The compact result remains explicitly engineering/model-resource and makes no physical nutrient claim.
Any protocol/replay/export omission fails the experiment rather than being skipped.
